tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// tshig gi gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ pa da ni dhiḥ bod skad du/ tshig gi gter/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs mi zad tshig gi gter// 'gro ba skyob mdzad la btud de// mkhas pa rnams kyi mdzod gyur pa// tshig gi gter 'di bdag gis dbye// byang phyogs 'di na tshig la mkhas pa med// legs par shes nas 'chad pa kho bo tsam// rtags kyi dbye ba phal cher 'dir mi 'jug /'on kyang bod la mkho ba mdo tsam bsdu// sangs

sangs rgyas spyi'i mtshan/ rgyas bde gshegs thams cad mkhyen// chos kyi rgyal po de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po bcom ldan 'das// rgyal ba bdud 'dul 'jig rten 'dul// mngon shes drug ldan stobs bcu pa// gnyis med gsung ba rnam 'dul mdzad// thub dbang dpal stug ston pa thub/ ༈ /shaka shaka thub kyi mtshan/ thub shākya'i seng ge dang*// don grub zas gtsang sras gau tam// sgyu 'phrul sras po nyi ma'i gnyen// gzhan yang skyob pa nyid gzigs dang*// bu ram shing pa la sogs pa'o/ ༈ /gnas mtho ris kyi ming*/ bzang sdig med sum rtsen dang*// lha yi 'jig rten skabs gsum gnas// rol pa gsum gnas mtho ris ming*// gzhan yang grub pa'i gnas sogs yod/ ༈ /'chi lha spyi'i ming*/ med rgas med skabs gsum lha// rnam sad bcud ldan tshigs bzang dang*// yid bzang sum rtsen dbang ldan dang*// mtho ris gnas dang mi sbyin skyes// mkhar nyal legs bris mi sbyin dga'// mi sbyin bu dang ṛ yig bu// mi rmi mi 'chi bdud rtsi zas// me zhal mchod sbyin zas ngag mtshon// sbyin byed dgra dang tshogs bzang ngo*// rig de'i rigs las byung ba'i ming*/ 'dzin chu byung gnod sbyin dang*// srung ma dri za mi 'am ci// sha za grub pa gsang ba pa// 'byung po 'di dag lha las byung*/ ༈ /lha min lha ma yin gyi ming*/ sbyin byed sbyin skyes dung*// gzhu rgyal dang ni dbang po'i dgra// khu ba'i slob ma sbyin ma'i bu// sngon gyi lha dang lha yi dgra/ ༈ /tshangs tshangs pa'i ming pa bdag skyes lha las rgan// mes po mchog gnas gser gyi mngal// rang byung gdong bzhi 'jig rten dbang*// byed po sdang byed chu skyes mngal// sgrub byed 'byin byed pad+ma'i stan// sna tshogs 'byin byed skye dgu'i bdag ༈ /khyab khyab 'jug gi ming*/ 'jug mi yi theg pa dang*// nag po biṣ+ṭā ra thos dang*// rtul mo'i bu dang thi gu'i lto// dbang po'i dbang phyug skra gcan gsod// sbrang rtsi'i bu dang rang las skyes// sbyin byed dgra bo pad dkar mig

/mkha' lding rgyal mtshan glang rdzir grags// mi 'dzag gos ser rwa gzhu can// sna tshogs sde can 'gro ba 'dzoms// nye dbang dbang pos brten pa dang*// lag pa bzhi pa 'khor lo'i lag /pad+ma'i lte ba sbrang rtsi'i dgra// nor lha'i bu dang rnam gsum gnon// lha mo dga' byed dpa' bo'i rgyud// dpal gyi bdag po skyes bu'i mchog /me tog phreng ldan stobs ldan 'joms// 'khar ba'i dgra dang 'og dbang skyes// kun skyob 'joms byed shes gsal thul// dpal be'us mtshan pa'i rin chen dga'// stobs bzang dang ni rab 'phyang gsod// stobs lha mi 'dzag sngon skyes dang*// nam gru dga' byed dga' byed dang*// 'dod skyong gshol mtshon gos sngon can// snar ma'i bu dang tā las mtshan// legs 'gugs thong ldan gtun shing can// dus ldan 'joms dang lag na gshol// stobs ldan zhes bya de yi spun/ ༈ /myos khyab 'jug bu'i ming byed yid srub gsod byed dang*// rab stobs dang ni nya yi tog /tshangs 'joms lus med 'dod ldan snyems// dran pa 'dod pa mda' lnga pa// sdom pa'i dgra dang yid las skyes// gzhan las skye med me tog mda'// dga' ma'i bdag po me tog gzhu// chu srin rgyal mtshan bdag las byung*/ ༈ /sna 'dod lha'i bu'i ming tshogs tog ldan tshangs pa skyes// nyan phrag bdag po ma 'gags pa/ ༈ /mtshon dpal mo'i ming byed pud+ma'i gzhal med khang*// pad+ma can dang ka ma la// dpal dang 'phrog byed dga' ba dung*// dbyangs bdag lnga skyes 'khor lo dang*/ ༈ /legs phyag mtshan la mthong sa mos be con dang*// ral gri dga' byed sa rengs dang*// nor bu zhes kyang grags pa yin/ ༈ /'dab mkha' lding ming ldan dug 'joms skar mig bu// rnam dul las skyes klu mthar byed// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug 'dab bzangs dang*// khyab 'jug shing rta lto 'gro za/ ༈ /bde dang phyug gi ming

'byung dbang phyug phyugs bdag dang*// mchog dga' dang ni mdung thogs dang*// dbang phyug dbang phyug chen po dang*// mthar gsod dbang ldan bde byed dang*// gtsug na zla ba 'byung po'i dbang*// dgra sta'i dum bu gangs ri'i bdag /ri yi bdag po sim byed dang*// pags pa'i gos can 'chi las rgyal// 'joms byed bdag po drag shul can// dpal mgrin 'gul gnag ral pa can// thod pa 'chang ba g.yon phyogs lha// mig mi bzang dag lha chen po// ri yi khu ba mig gsum pa// kun mkhyen ral pa'i khur bu can// za bo dran po 'phrog byed dang*// 'jigs byed gsum lha gaṅgā 'dzin// grong gsum mthar byed long ba'i dgra// mchod sbyin 'joms byed nam mkha'i skra// khyu mchog rgyal mtshan srin pa 'jigs// rtag gnas drag po u ma'i bdag /gzhan las dran dgra rtse gsum can// mgrin sngon la sogs grags pa yod/ ༈ /ral pa bcings pa ka ra dha/ ༈ /de yi 'khor ni 'joms byed do/ ༈ /u ma kā t+yā'i u ma'i ming bu mo dang*// dkar mo nag mo gser ldan ma// dbang ldan zhi ma srid pa ma// drag mo gsod ma lo ma med// kun la bkra shis ri khrod ma// gtum mo sim byed rdzong na gnas// kun gyi ma rnams btsun mo'i ming*/ ༈ /log tshogs bdag ming 'dren bgegs kyi rgyal po dang*// tshogs kyi bdag po ma gnyis pa// he ram+ba dang lto 'phyang ba// mche ba gcig pa glang po'i gdong*/ ༈ /sde smin drug ming chen dang ni smin drug bu// 'dam bu'i tshal skyes dgong drug pa// ri khrod ma dga' ngud mo dang*// sde dpon dang ni mang po skyes// sgrol byed 'dul ba sa ga skyes// gtsug phud can zhon ma drug pa// mdung thogs gzhon nu khrung khrung 'joms/ ༈ /dbang brgya byin ming po dang ni ma ru twān// ma gha las skyes 'od khyab dang*// smin pa 'dul byed bi ḍo dzāḥ /rgan las thos su nā shī ra// pu ru hū taḥgrong 'joms dang*// dziṣ+ṇu rle kha ra ṣa bhaḥ

/nus ldan mchod sbyin brgya pa dang*// mtho ris bdag po legs skyob dang*// ri 'joms dbyig ldan rdo rje can// gnas bdag char 'bebs sgrib skyob 'joms// lha yi bdag po stobs kyi dgra// bde sogs bdag po rmugs 'joms dang*// 'phrog byed rta dang swa ra ṇu// ngur 'jug dang ni mi gtong gsod// mi nyams bzod dka' gzhan snyems theg /mig stong kun 'joms sprin la zhon// mtho ris gnas pa'o gzhan las ni// ko'u shi ka la sogs grags/ ༈ /de de'i btsun mo sogs kyi ming yi btsun mo dbang mo dang*// bden smra mthong las skyes zhes grags/ ༈ /de yi grong khyer 'chi med gnas// khang bzang rnams rgyal bdun sa ni// chos bzang nags ni dga' ba'i tshal/ ༈ /de yi glang chen mtsho byung dang*// sprin gyi glang po sgra sgrogs dang*// sgra 'byin sprin grol ma yi khyo/ ༈ /kha lo ba ni mā ta li/ ༈ /de'i rta mthor thos mtshon cha ni/ ༈ /rdo rje lag nyal 'jigs byed dang*// dag byed dang ni rtse brgya pa// sgra can bde ldan bsgyings 'gro dang*// za byed ces bya nam mkha' la// 'gro ba'i theg pa bi mā na/ ༈ /btung bya bdud rtsi btung bde yin/ ༈ /chu bo dal 'bab mtho ris klung*// nam mkha'i gaṅgā lha rings so/ ༈ /'tsher byed lhun po gser gyi ri// rin chen rdul brtsegs lha yi gnas/ ༈ /ljon shing yid mos rgya mtsho skyes// legs rgyas dang ni dpag bsam shing*// dbang po tshim byed rnam pa lnga/ ༈ /kun 'gyed gzhon nu rnam byed bu// swa rbai d+yā dang rgod ma'i bu// mi bden med dang tha skar skyes// nad sel zhes bya lha mo rnams// chu byung swa rbe sh+yā urba sī sogs/ ༈ /me dang me lha'i ming 'khyogs 'bar bsreg za dang*// nor las rgyal dang chu'i skye gnas// gsal byed skyes thob lus 'phel dang*// lam nag skems byed shing las 'phel// 'bar ba'i skra can snga dro 'bar// rten za 'od chen 'phrog byed dang*// dag byed 'tsho byed rta dmar can// rlung gi grogs po gtsug phud can// rtswa zan gser gyi khu ba dang*// bsreg za sreg byed mtshun thob byed// dul 'gro 'od 'grib 'od bdun pa// 'od gsal 'od bkra 'od nor can/

༈ /chu rgod ma kha sogs kyi ming mkhris brang skyes rgod ma can// me'o me 'od 'bar dang bcings// mchod bya der 'gro nyal yul dang*// 'phros 'gro me yi zegs ma dang*/ ༈ /yongs su gdung ba tshad pa can/ ༈ /chos kyi gshin rje'i ming rgyal po pha yi bdag /mtshun 'jug mthar byed rab song rgyal// zhi sgrub ya mu na yi spun// dus 'dzin gsod byed bka' sdod dang*// nyi ma'i bu dang mtshun la rol/ ༈ /srul srin po'i ming po za byed sha za dang*// khrag 'thung kun gsod mtshan mor rgyu// mtshan mor spyod dang snyan par bstod// gsod byed bdag skyes mthar 'gro sbyin// bsod nams skye bo phyogs kyi bu// mthar 'gro dang ni bsrung ba pa// rab sems chu lha'i ming mchog ster zhags pa can// chu spyod bdag po chu bdag dang*// dbugs 'byin rlung lha'i ming reg byed ma bdag nyal// rtag 'gro dri len rta dmar can// dri bzhon gnas med myur 'gro dang*// sim byed sim pa yang dag rgyu// 'gro ba'i ngang tshul skyes 'gro'i srog /mnga' bdag dag byed rab 'joms so/ ༈ /srog lus kyi rlung sogs gyi ming dang thur ser mnyam gnas dang*// gyen rgyu khyab byed lus kyi rlung*/ ༈ /myur myur ba'i ming ba nyid sgrol shugs ldan 'gro// mgyogs pa la gor skyen pa yud// thabs cig mi sdod de ma thag ༈ /rtag rtag tu'i ming tu rgyun tu mi ngal ba// rgyun mi 'chad dang bar med sogs// lus rnam thos sras kyi ming ngan grogs po mig gsum pa// gsang ba'i bdag po gnod sbyin rgyal// mi yi chos ldan nor sbyin rgyal// rgyal po dang ni nor gyi bdag /mi'am ci dbang rnam thos sras// 'od yangs bu pho mi la zhon// mchod sbyin dmar ser mig ya can// dpal ster dbang phyug bsod nams skyes/ ༈ /sna tshogs de'i tshal sogs kyi ming

shing rta de yi tshal/ ༈ /de yi bu ni gar mkhan mchog ༈ /gangs can gnas yin grong khyer ni// brgyan pa can yin de'i shing rta// me tog rgyas pa can zhes bya/ ༈ /mi'am ci dang ci'i skyes bu// rta yi gdong can 'gro mgyogs pa/ ༈ /gter gyi gtso bo gnyen gter de// dbye na dung dang pad+ma sogs/ ༈ /lha nam mkha'i ming rtsen rol sa 'khor lo dang*// kun 'gebs go 'byed chu sgrogs dang*// mi gsal kun 'gro dbus nas gsal// bar med mtha' bral lha yi lam// mi 'da' rtag sdod khyab 'jug gnas// kun gsal rnam grol nam mkha'i ming*// kun phyogs spyi'i ming khyab gsal gnas nyi mas ston// 'phrog byed rnams ni phyogs kyi'o/ ༈ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs rnams su// dbang po la sogs rim bzhin gnas/ ༈ /rgya phyogs kyi glang po'i ming mtsho las byung pad+ma dkar// g.yon bcings mchod 'gro sa la mos// me tog so dang sa steng grags// cha mdzes phyogs kyi glang po brgyad// de dag glang mo'i ming chung ma sprin grol ma// ser skya ma dang dmar ser ma// dpe med ma dang zangs rna ma// dge ba'i so can yan lag can// mchod ldan ces bya rim pa bzhin/ ༈ /lcags ri mu khyud khor yug go ༈ /chu sprin gyi ming 'dzin sim byed chu khur dang*// chu yi gzhon pa sgra sgrogs dang*// rgyun 'dzin brlan 'dzin glog can dang*// sel byed chu yis mgu byed dang*// chu 'byin du ba'i skye gnas can// ka dam+ba can sprin gyi phreng*/ ༈ /'brug 'brug gi ming sgra sgra sgrogs sprin gyi sgra// sgra can dang ni sgra brgya pa/ ༈ /sa glog gi ming srung can dang skad cig gsal/ ༈ /glog dang rnam gsal g.yo 'gul can/ ༈ /'phro thog gi ming 'joms rdo rje'i zer 'phro ba// sprin gyi 'od zer chu las 'bar/ ༈ /dbang 'ja' tshon gyi ming po'i mtshon cha brgya byin gzhu// 'ja' tshon ming yin de drang na// ro hi taṃ zhes bya bar grags/

༈ /char char pa'i ming pa dgung char char rgyun dang*// yongs lhung dang ni kun nas 'bab// chu yi zigs ma bad zil can// gzhan las sprin gyi bcud dang ni// mkha' las babs dang sprin las byung*/ ༈ /rdo char ser ba'i ming sdang byed ser ba'i ming*/ ༈ /de la than pa'i ming gnod byed than pa sogs// sprin yul ngan gyi ming gyis sgrib byed nyi ma ngan// mngon par mi gsal nye bar nub// khebs pa zhes bya yul ngan ming*/ ༈ /bsil zla ba'i ming zer can dang sim byed 'od// zla ba dbang po ku mud gnyen// byed mkhas bdud rtsi'i 'od can dang*// 'od dkar can dang rtsi'i dbang phyug /mtshan mo'i bdag po chu las skyes// srog 'tsho chags bskyed 'grib pa can// ri dwags mtshan pa cha shas gter// gnyis skyes rgyal po ri bong 'dzin// rgyu skar dbang phyug mtshan mor byed// cha shas can dang bcu drug cha// 'od gzugs dkyil 'khor can phye ba// cha nus dum bu yan lag ldan// 'od ldan kun phan sim 'od can// rab gsal rang snub oṃ mtshan dang*// rtags can mtshon byed legs zhi ba// mchog tu mdzes pa mdzes pa dang*// 'tsher ldan gsal byed 'gebs pa'o// khug khug rna'i ming rna lho 'ur ba mo dang*/ ༈ /'tsher byed kha ba 'jig las skyes// mchod bya khu 'phang bsil yon can/ ༈ /brtan rtod phur gyi ming gnas dang ni gan rkyal bu/ ༈ /ri a ga s+t+ya'i ming byi dang ni bum pa skyes// grogs po dang ni chu lha'i bu// mi 'gyur skar ma 'od can dang*// sgrol ma can dang mdongs sel ma// dā k+ṣa'i bu mo rgod tha skar gyi ming ma can// kun sgrub rgyal stod kyi ming rnam khyab rgyas byed dang*// grub gro zhun gyi ming pa tshim byed legs nyan dang*/ ༈ /nor khrums kyi ming ldan ba lang khyu mchog rkang*/ ༈ /ri smal po/ dwags mgo can ri dwags mgo

/de nyid lo yi dang po yin// steng gi char gnas skar ma dpyid/ ༈ /che ba'i bdag po lha'i slob dpon// blo ldan bla ma dbyangs bdag po// 'tsho byed dang ni 'gro ldan bu// smra ba'i bdag po gtsug phud bkra// dum skyes zhes bya phur bu'i ming*/ ༈ /khu ba sbyin pa wa sangs kyi ming byed bla ma dang*// snyan ngag bu pho mdog mdzes dang*// bhṛ gu'i bu dang snyan ngag mkhan/ ༈ /rol mig dmar gyi ming 'gro sa skyes sa las byung*// lus dmar dang ni sa yi bu// gzhan las bkra shis zhes su grags// bra lhag pa'i ming nye'i bu pho rtogs ldan dang*// zla ba'i bu ni gza' lhag go ༈ /dal spen pa'i ming 'gro spen pa'o mun sgra gcan ming can dang*// sgra gcan dang ni mtho ris gsal// seng ge can dang zla ba za// khyim

khyim gyi ming rnams 'char ba dus sbyor te// de ni lug dang glang la sogs/ ༈ /snang nyi ma'i ming 'byung chu 'od bla med gsal// mi sbyin skyes dang bcu gnyis bdag /snang byed nyin byed 'od byed pa// rab tu gsal byed rnam gsal byed// 'od ldan khyab gsal rta bdun pa// rta ljang dang ni 'od drod can// rnam bsgyur mchod 'os ma zlum dang*// char 'bebs 'ong 'gro gso bar byed// nam mkha'i nor bu sgrol byed bshes// 'od bkra rnam par snang byed dang*// gza' yi bdag po 'od nor can// snang bdag dang ni nyin mo'i bdag /'od gsal gsod byed 'od stong 'phro// gdung ba 'od 'byin mthus bsgrags so/ ༈ /gnas byed dmar ser dbyug pa dang*// gtum pa'i 'od kyis yongs su bskor/ ༈ /kha kha lo ba'i ming lo ba ni 'od dmar dang*// brla med ces bya 'od srung dang*// mkha' lding zhes bya sdun 'gro ba'o/ ༈ /yongs nyi ma'i gur su bskor ba yongs 'dzin dang*// nye ba'i nyi ma dkyil 'khor can/ ༈ /mun 'od zer gyi ming sel ro byed 'jal 'phro snang*// phyogs kyi mthar 'gro chu snom dregs// gsal ba 'od byed 'od zer can// ri smig rgyu'i ming dwags sred dang 'chir 'jug ni// smig dus kyi rnam grangs mdor bstan pa rgyu'o dus kyi rnam grangs ni// bgrang bya dus dang tshod dang ni// yang dag 'gro zhes bya bar grags// tshes tshes sogs rgyas par bshad pa gcig phyogs rtsa rnam grangs yin// mun nyin mo'i ming bsal nyin mo sdong 'joms dang*// mi ldog rtsen dus gnas 'jug dang*// mi snga dro'i ming sgrib sang dus nyin mo'i sgo// nam phyi dro'i ming langs zhes bya'o nyin mo'i mtha'// nyi bsgyur legs gnas pha skyes dang*// mel thun mtshams kyi ming tshe zhes bya thun mtshams ming*// snga dro phyi dro nyi ma gung*// thun

mtshan mo'i ming tshod gsum yin mtshan mo'i ming*// bya bral phrar 'jug gnas dus dang*// thun gsum pa dang dal ba ster// snang ba zlog byed mun pa can// rdul can dang ni thun tshod can// zhir 'jug snang med mtshan mo che// zla dkar rkyang zla snang ba can// tshigs dkar nag gi phyogs ngos gzung ba mtshams tshes gcig bco lnga'i bar// bco lnga gnyis po phyogs kyi mtha'/ ༈ /'jal tshes bco lnga'i ming byed gang ba'am zla ba nya/ ༈ /cha gnam stong gi ming gcig nyams pa rjes 'du zer// nyi zla 'dus phyir lhan gnas pa'am// 'di na gnam stong zhes su grags/ ༈ /zla zla ba mthong ba'i dus mthong tshes pa'am gzhon nu can/ ༈ /ma ma mthong ba'i dus mthong chang can ku hur grags/ ༈ /nyi bsgyur nyi ma gzas bzung ba'i ming gzas bzung sgra gcan zos// 'di na spyang gis zin zhes grags// nyi zla cig sbyor me tog can// mig dus la sogs pa brtsam tshul 'dzums bco brgyad mthar gnas la// de ni sum cus bgrang ba yin// de sum cu la skad cig go /de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin// de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag bco lnga phyogs su grags// snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis// de gnyis bsdoms pas 'jal byed yin// mā mchu zla ghā la sogs gnyis gnyis la// dus tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho byang bgrod pa gnyis la lo// nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i bi ṣu pa// 'phel 'grib med pa zhes kyang grags// me zla ba tog ldan pa'i zla ba nya// rgyal gyi zla ba gang yin de// ming ni rgyal yin mchu la sogs// lhag ma bcu gcig de bzhin no/ ༈ /ri dwags mgo can mig 'byed dang*// lo 'go zhes bya smal po'i ming*/ ༈ /rgyal dang tai ṣa mi mjed gsum/ ༈ /dka' thub zla ba mchu gnyis so// 'bras bu'i zla ba dka' thub bzang*// dbo yin nag pa can nag pa// 'dod zla'o sa ga sbrang mgu byed/

༈ /thu bo khu ba dag byed zla/ ༈ /mi bzod chu 'dzag mkha' sgra'o/ ༈ /sprin bzang ba lang ba lang rkang*// khyu mchog rkang pa khrums kyi ming*/ ༈ /rgod ma ltad mo'i zla ba dang*// rgod ma can ni tha skar ming*/ ༈ /smin drug mang ster spro ba can/ ༈ /kha ba 'bab dang grang ba'i dus// dgun stod dgun smad rim pa bzhin// dpyid dang me tog dus bde byed// rdul dus tshad zla nges sreg dus// drod phebs drod 'ongs tshad pa can// char zla dang ni char pa'i dus// 'di na chu yi zla yang zer// ston ka gzhan las smin pa'i dus// 'di na dpyid zla ra ba sogs// gsum tshan bzhi ru phye ste smra/ ༈ /ongs bgrang bgrang gzhi rang skyob dang*// 'dor byed ces bya lo yi ming*/ ༈ /yongs 'joms rab thim rab nub dang*// zad pa rab nub mtha' zhes bya// bskal pa'i ming yin gzhan du ni// 'jig dus dus mtha' zad dus zer/ ༈ /reg sdig pa'i ming 'phel bsrung bya ngan 'thung dang*// dmas byed dge 'dzad rko byed dang*// snub byed dang ni bzang po spangs// mtshar 'gro dang ni bzang la 'byol// nyes byas rnams ni sdig pa'i ming*/ ༈ /'dzin dge ba'i ming pa yang sbyor rab bsngags dang*// legs byas 'dod 'bab dga' byed tshim// rab dga' dga' dang rab mgu byed// rangs byed spro byed kun dga' dang*/ ༈ /sdig bsod nams kyi ming srob legs rko bzang dge dang*// bsngags 'os zhi byed bzang po dang*// phan thob bzang snyegs dge legs dang*// skal bzang skal can skal ldan dang*// ngan sel bstod 'os mi dge bskyung*// bsod nams ming yin bsngags pa yi// rnam grangs gzhan ni 'di rjes 'byung*// ༈ //lhas dbang thang gi ming bskos bskos bstan bgo skal dang*// skal ba sngon byas rnam grangs te// 'di ni phywas bskos kha rjer grags// ༈ //rgyu sa bon gyi ming dang byed pa khyad 'gro dang*// 'byung gzhi thog ma'i byed pa po// gzhan las nyer len sogs drug bshad/

༈ /zhing bdag gi ming shes bdag dang skyes bu dang*// gtso gtso bo la sogs pa'i ming bo rang bzhin khyad par dang*// dus 'byung gnas skabs yon tan te// gnas pa skye ba thim pas na// yon tan gsum yin gzhan du'ang 'dod/ ༈ /skye skye bo'i ming ba skye bo skyed byed skye// bskrun dang 'byung ba rnam grangs sgra// srog ldan shes can skye ldan dang*// srog chags skye bo lus can dang*// sems can sems pa snying can dang*// sgrogs byed 'phrog byed nyal byed nyal// yid blo gros kyi ming 'gro rtsol byed blo shes rab// nyal slong blo gros rab mthong dang*// nyer dmigs sems pa legs rtogs dang*// bsam pa go ba khong du chud// kun chub 'dzin blo rtog dpyod kyi ming yang dag rtogs// sems kyi longs spyod yid kyi las// yid la byed dang dpyod pa dang*// bgrang dang rnam par dpyod pa dang*// kun nas sdud dang rtogs pa dang*// mno bsam dang the tshom gyi ming ni som nyi dang*// the tshom snyam pa yid gnyis dang*/ ༈ /gtan nges pa'i ming la phebs dang nges pa dang*/ ༈ /log log lta'i ming par lta dang med pa ba/ ༈ /'tshe gnod sems kyi ming byed dang ni 'khu ba'i sems/ ༈ /grub grub mtha'i ming mtha' dang ni bzung ba'i mtha'/ ༈ /'khrul blo 'khrul ba'i ming ba log blo 'khor ba dang*/ ༈ /khas dam bca'i ming 'che phyogs bzung dam bca' dang*// nges byas mnyan byas yongs thos pa// bdag gir byas dang khas blangs dang*// so sor mnyan dang legs bzung dang*// thar pa'i blo gros ye shes so/ ༈ /rnam rnam shes kyi ming shes bzo yi bstan bcos shes// grol rnam par byang ba'i ming ba ma 'dres mya ngan 'das// rab bsngags 'chi med nges par legs// thar pa dang ni spangs pa'o/ ༈ /mi ngar 'dzin gyi ming shes ma rig ngar 'dzin blo/

༈ /gzugs sgra dri ro yul spyi'i ming reg bya yul// spyod yul dbang po'i ming dbang don bde byed dang*// yul can bdag rtag dbang po'i ming*// las kyi dbang po kha la sogs// blo yi bdag rtag mig la sogs/ ༈ /bska yul so sor las re'i ming ba chu ster mngar ba dang*// lan tshwa tsha ba rnon po skyur/ ༈ /rnam dri bzang gi ming nyid sbyar spos 'gro yid 'phrog /kun mos dri bzang ring nas 'gugs// nges 'phrog legs 'thul sna tshim byed// 'dod dri dri zhim ngan bzang ste// rul dri ngan gyi ming dri dri ngan dri btsog sogs/ ༈ /dkar dkar po'i ming po dkar gsal 'od gsal dang*// mdog dkar gzhan gcod dkar snum dang*// skya bseng dag mdog yid sdebs dang*// mdog bsngags mig stobs dkar dag dang*// srid ngang mdog gi ming sgrub skya bo ri dwags mdog /ngang pa'o nag po nag po'i ming sngon po dang*// dkar min sngo bsangs mdog nag dang*// rnying ma'i mdog go ser po ser po'i ming dang*// mdog bsngags dang ni yung ba'i mdog /ljang ljang gu'i ming gu ljang ser lo ma'i mdog /'di na dmar po'i ming bsrubs kha'o dmar po dang*// mdog dmar dmar dang khrag mdog dang*/ ༈ /ka leb rgan gyi ming na da mdog mi gsal na// skya rengs dmar skya pā ṭa la/ ༈ /du dud ka'i ming mdog dud ka dmar nag la'o// ser skya ser skya'i ming dkar ser ser bseng dang*// dmar ser rkyang zer 'di na ni// skyer kha zhes grags bkra sna tshogs kyi ming ba dang*// sna tshogs bgrang snang 'dres ma dang*// khra bo zhes bsgrags rnam grangs sgra/ ༈ /tshangs sgra spyi'i ming byung gso bsgrags brjod pa dang*// dbyangs dang sgra dang sgra can dang*// mtsho byung rnam brjod gang ba dang*// smra dang 'chad dang bshad dang lab// zur chag dang ni sgra nyams pa// rjod

lung du ston pa'i sgra'i ming byed bstan bcos sgra la ni// te nga sub kyi mtha' can ngag /byed pa'am bya ba dang ldan pa/ ༈ /thos rig byed kyi ming pa rig byed gsum man ngag /gsum pa'i chos ni de'i cho ga /snyan ngag nges brjod mchod sbyin gsum// 'di gsum rig byed gsum po yin// bslab sogs thos pa'i yan lag go ༈ /oṃ 'don pa la 'jug tshul gyi yi ge phyag 'tshal ba// i ti hā saḥpū rā pṛt+ta da// ut+ta ta la sogs gsum dbyangs// ā lung gi rjes su rtog cing 'byed pa nī k+ṣi kī daṇ+ḍī lugs// rtog rtog ge'i ming ge rig pa don bstan bcos// ā bstan bcos spyi'i ming khya yi ko pa lab+dha// pū ra ṇa ni mtshan nyid lnga// rtog 'jig rten gtam rgyud kyi ming pas rab tu bcings pa'i gtam// pra ban+dhi kā pra he li kā ༈ /dran pa chos yang dag bsdus pa'i ming par bsdus// legs bsdus pa dang bsdus pa'o// tshig bsdu ba dang bsdus pa'i don// skye bos gtam smra pa'i ming thos pa gang ci'ang rung brjod// bār+t+ta pra bṛt+tī pra bṛt+tā n+dā// u dan+ta s+t+ya da ā khyā// ā he a bhi dha na dang*// ming brjod pa dang ming dang ni// hū tiḥ.ā kā ra ṇā hā ṇa// saṃ hū hi ni mang pos byas// rtsod rtsod pa'i ming pa dang ni tha snyad dang*// nye bsnyon 'debs pa'i ming bar dgod pa smra ba'i sgo// u pod+ghā ta u dā hā ra// mna' mna'i ming dang bros 'don 'dir dbu bsnyung*// 'dri 'dri ba'i ming ba shes 'dod rjes su sbyor// lan lan gyi ming dang slar brjod rjes ston pa/ ༈ /log rdzun tshig gi ming pa'i sbyor ba ngan brjod dang*/ ༈ /log skur 'debs kyi ming par bsngags pa mngon par smod// legs bsngags pa'i ming pa ston sgra rjes chags skyes/

༈ /mchod snyan bsgrags kyi ming tshig legs sgrog yang dag shes/ ༈ /bstod bstod pa'i ming pa bstod sgra bstod tshig bstod// skyor tshig gnyis gsum brjod pa'o// sgra gsang mthon po dbyangs yin no// gcong skad mo yi rnam 'gyur te/ ༈ /mya ngan sogs las byung ba'i sgra/ ༈ /mi smod pa'i ming bsngags bsdigs tshig nges par rgol// yongs smod sun 'byin khro tshig dang*// gshe dang brgyad dang smod pa dang*// tshig rtsub rgol ba sma 'bebs tshig ༈ /chags pa'i khro ba 'khrig pa'i gzhi// kun brjod dang ni yongs sgra dang*// lab lob dang ni don med gtam// rjes su smra tshig zlos pa'i ming dang yang yang smra// rnam smra tshig 'gal ba'i ming dang ni yongs gdung tshig /cal col dang ni 'gal ba'i tshig /dab dib sgra mi gsal ba'i ming dang ni grong gtam dang*// legs legs par brjod pa'i ming par smra dang legs bshad dang*// gsang sgra gsong gtam nyid yin no// phan phan tshig gi ming byed smra ba 'phyon ma'i tshig /dge gtam 'jam gtam 'phrod gtam dang*// snying tshig rtsub kyi ming la 'bab pa gdung tshig dang*// tshig rtsub grong pa tshig mi legs// gtam dga' ba bskyed pa'i tshig gi ming snyan dga' byed bden pa dang*// glen blun tshig gi ming tshig nyon mongs phan tshun 'gal// mi gsal ma rdzogs brjod nyams dang*// myur mchil tshig gi ming brjod chu tshig mchil ma can// ma 'brel med tshig gi ming 'brel don med yi ge bral// brjod bya med pa gsog dang rdzun// mi bden tshig gi ming gsal mi bden de nyid dang*// yid 'byung de bzhin yid 'bab dang*// yang dag bden pa'o gzhan las ni// mi slu ba la sogs pa'ang grags// sgra dang nges sgrogs lung du mi ston pa'i sgra rnams kyi ming grag pa dang*// sgrogs pa ca co ku co dang*// lhang tser ding 'ur shu sgra sogs// shod sgra gos sgra lo ma yi// khral khrol ces bya rgan gyi sgra/

༈ /kwa ṇa ཿkwa ṇa ཿla sogs dang*// sngon du ni dang pra byin pa// dri za sogs kyi pi wang sgra/ ༈ /ca co dar dir la sogs pa// mang po mi gsal ba yi sgra// 'bu sgra la sogs dud 'gro'i sgra/ ༈ /sgra brnyan lan sgra 'dir brag ca/ ༈ /glu dang dbyangs mtshungs 'dren pa la// 'dres dang khyu mchog gan+dha ra// drug skyes par ma blo gsal ba// lnga pa zhes bya'i dkyus bdun pa'o/ ༈ /pi wang dang ni mgul pa'i sgra// sgra cha phra ba kā ka li// mi gsal snyan pa dh+wa ni yin/ ༈ /zab mo sgra ni man+t+ra ste// shin tu mthon po tā ra'o// 'a ya thams cad mnyam pa yin// pheg rdob rnar 'jug balka li// rnam spros dang ni rgyud can no// rgyud bdun pa ri bā di ni// pi wang sogs sgra ta taṃ yin// ā nad+dha dang murdza sogs// gling bu sogs la bug can// 'khar rnga pheg rdob sogs sil snyan// rnam pa 'di bzhi rol ma'i sgra// mṛ taṃ ga dang murdza dang*// de yi bye brag aṃ kyā dang*// a liṅge dang ur+dha ka'o// ya shaḥpa ḍa haḥṭak+ka// bhai ri ā na ka dang ni// dun+du bhi dang ā na ka /pa ḍa haḥdang ko na dang*// pi wang khog pa phra bā la// de yi rtse mo ka ku bha// rab bsdams pa zhes bya bar grags// 'phangs 'gro'o rtsa bar ldems pa'i shing*// u pa na ho zhes bya'o// rol mo'i bye brag du ma ru// mad du ḍiṇ+ḍi dzha dza ra// marda la dang pa ṇa ba// ༈ //gar mkhan dang ni rol mo ba// dal dang myur dar bar ma la// ta twa o go ga ṇaṃ zer// de sogs gar gyi skabs don 'ga'// bod la mkho ba chung phyer bzhag /sgeg

nyams kyi ming mdor bstan pa pa dpa' ba snying rje dang*// ngam pa rgod dang 'jigs su rung*// mi sdug drag shul nyams brgyad do/ ༈ /sgig rgyas par bshad pa pa gtsang ba rab 'bar ba// spro ba bskyed dang dpa' ba yin// snying rje bde 'gog bdag dbang byed// thugs rje gtong dang rjes su brtse// rjes su khro ba'o rgod pa dang*// bzhad pa rgod bag gad mo 'byin/ ༈ /mi sdug pa yi rnam par 'gyur/ ༈ /ngo mtshar rmad byung mtshar che ba// sna tshogs zhes bya'o 'jigs rung dang*// 'dar 'jug dang ni 'jigs byed dang*// nyam nga can dang 'jigs pa dang*// 'jigs sde 'jigs pa 'jigs par byed// skrag byed so sor 'jigs drag po// drag shul zhes bya 'di dag nyams// 'jigs skrag la sogs thun mong pa// yid kyi rnam nyams kyi khyad par ming 'gyur ngo bo dang*// nyams dang rjes myong go byed do// snyems nga rgyal gyi ming pa mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang*// ngar byed nga rgyal yid mtho ba'o// ma ma gus pa'i ming dad zal gnon yongs su smod// zhum byed mtshang dgod mchod mi byed// shes par mi byed ma brtsis pa// mi mos pa'o 'di na ni// mtshang 'bru rgol dang shung pa dang*// brgyad bkag la sogs gzhan yang grags// mig ngo tsha ba'i ming dman ngo tsha ngo mi 'dzem// zhum zhing pa gong 'khums pa'ang zer// bzod bzod pa'i ming pa gtong 'os mngon snyems dang*// mi phrag dog gi ming bzod phrag dog skyon sgro 'dogs// dpal khon 'dzin gyi ming bskyed 'gal ba rnam par 'gog ༈ /sems sdug mya ngan gyi ming mya ngan gdung ba'o/ ༈ /phyi 'gyod pa'i ming nas gdung ba rjes gdung dang*// rnam par snyil ba 'gyod pa'o/ ༈ /khro khro ba'i ming ba 'khrug pa ma rungs pa// mi mnogs gzhan bsnun sems 'khrug pa// gtsang tshul khrims ming bar spyod pa tshul khrims so// smyo

'khrul sems la sems rnam par 'khrul ba'o// nyams dga' ba'i ming dga' dga' nyid snying sang dga'// sems snum 'di ni dgyes pa sogs// 'dod 'dod pa'i ming pa re ba 'dod spro dang*// thob 'dod sred pa chags rnyed 'dod// yid kyi shing rta 'dod chags dang*// mngon 'dod zhen pa de che na// rngams che 'di na zhe nyer grags/ ༈ /nyer don sems pa'i ming 'dzin chos sems kun 'dzin yid// yid gdung gcags pa shin tu sems// spro ba zhen pa'o brtson brtson 'grus kyi ming ldan yid// de tshe rdul ldan phong tshangs g.yo sgyu'i ming 'gro// snyad ka rang mthong snyad 'dogs dang*// 'gebs dang khram dang ngan kyog dang*// ngan byed g.yo can bag med dang*// yid mi rton yin 'di na ni// lhod la sogs pa'ang cha mthun yin/ ༈ /mtshar bzhad gad kyi ming 'dod dga' 'dod skyo bsangs dang*// sdig sel 'di na ku rer grags// bud bud med sgeg pa'i ming med rnams kyi rtse ba la// rol pa dang ni stegs 'gros dang*// rnam skor sgeg 'gros nyams dga' sogs// hā bāḥzhes grags bya ba rnams// sgeg pa las byung nyams su bshad// 'dzag rtsed mo'i ming dang rtse dang gad mo dang*// rol rtsed 'jo sgeg g.yer bag dang*// snyad ka 'khyog tshig mtshon pa dang*// byis rtsed rtse ba rtsed mo'o/ ༈ /lus rngul gyi ming chu rngul dang lus kyi rngul// sems dran pa med pa'i ming stor snya dang sems nyams dang*// hon stong pa dang rnam 'gyur sbed// 'ur dang shin tu 'bros pa'o/ ༈ /ga gad mo'i ming chad kun nas dga' dang dgod// chung ngu 'dzum pa'o bar ma ni// gad mo'i spu ldang ba spu langs// ngu ngu ba'i ming 'bod cho nge mchi ma 'dzag /glal dang g.yal ba'i ming g.yal ba'o bslu ba'i ming bslu ba dang*/ 'drid tshig ngag 'bras gzhan pa dang*// yid brtan med pa'o gnyid dang ni// nyal

nyal ba'i ming dang gzims dang rmi lam dang*// legs phab snya dang glo phab pa// smin khros pa'i 'gyur ba la/ bsdus khro gnyer smin mtshams bsdus/ ༈ /dga' dga' ston gyi ming ston mchod chen lha gsol lo// mtho ris kyi sde'o// ༈ //'og sa 'og gi ming ma sa 'og rkang 'og dang*// stobs ldan gnas dang bcud 'og dang*// klu yi 'jig rten bu ga mtshar/ ༈ /khung dang bu ga khung bu'i ming khung bu dang*// bu gu bug pa dmigs khung dang*// gsal mthongs mkha' mthongs rlung 'byung rnams// thun mong ming yin sa khung dang*// sa phug dong sgo dong bug sgo// ldongs byed mun pa zhi ldan mun pa'i ming dang*// rab rib nyer nub mun nag smag /mthug na she mun srab na ni// nam mkha' dag pa zhes bya'o// kun khyab mun khyab bgrod med mun// ka klu'i rgyal po'i ming dru'i bu dang lhag ma dang*// mtha' yas nor rgyas sbrul can dang*/ ༈ /ba sbrul bye brag gi ming lang sna dang thig le'i lus// a dza ga nyal rlung gis dga'// chu sbrul dang ni myur 'gro 'dod// thig le dkar ldan rnga bo che// kla klo gso dang kla klo'i sbrul// shun shun pa brje ba'i ming pa brjes pa go cha grol/ ༈ /sa sbrul spyi'i ming la reg 'gro sa la 'phye// 'khyog 'gro gya gyu 'khyug 'gro 'phye// mche ba dug can dug 'dzin dang*// 'gros kyog rnam 'dzin 'khor lo can// 'khyil pa rkang sbas mig gis thos// lto 'phye gdengs can gzar bu mgo /rgyab rings zas ngan khung du nyal// brang 'gro rkang gis mi 'gro dang*// rmugs 'gro dang ni 'phel ka can// rlung za'o sbrul las byung ba ni// dug dang rus pa la sogs so// s+phu ṭa yān dang gdengs ka'i ming pha ṇā gnyis// kañtsu ka dang ni rmo ka ༈ /k+ṣe sbrul dug gi ming ḍa ga ra laṃ gi dug /kā ko la dang kā la kū ṭa// ha la ha lā sā roṣ+ṭi ka

/solki ka dang tshangs pa'i bu// pra dī pa naḥdā ra da// be'u'i lte ba zhes bya ba// dug gi dbye ba rnam dgu'o/ ༈ /dug dug gi sman pa'i ming gi sman pa dug sel dang*/ ༈ /sbrul sbrul 'dzin ba'i ming 'dzin dang ni tuṇ+ḍi ka ༈ /dmyal dmyal ba'i ming ba dang ni ngan 'gro'i mthil// 'dod 'bras bral dang ngan 'gro'o// de yi dbye ba tsha ba sogs/ ༈ /yi dwags grub yi dwags kyi ming med 'tshod pa la min// 'gro bral ngan khyab bla med de'i sdug bsngal gyi ming dang*// brnag dka' ngan myong tsher ma rtsub// na ba bro nad sdug bsngal dang*// yid 'grogs dang ni skye las skyes// dka' dang gcod sbyor 'jigs pa len/ ༈ /zla rgya mtsho'i ming bas 'phel dang chu 'dzin dang*// pha rol mi mngon pha rol sgrib// chu klung bdag po chu ldan dang*// chu srel dang ni 'bab ldan dang*// chu can dug can chu rgyun can// rin chen 'byung gnas chu gter dang*// chu srin bdag po chu yi bdag ༈ /de de'i bye brag gi ming yi bye brag 'o chu dang*// tsha chu ba tsha'i chu dang ni// zho chu dang ni chu yi chu// mar gyi chu dang bur shing chu// chang gi chu dang zhim chu'o/ ༈ /khyab chu la pa mnyam sgrib thur du 'gro// 'dod bya 'bru phan 'gog byed dang*// 'ching byed mi 'chi 'tsho ba dang*// 'byung byed rten pa lus 'ching dang*// 'dzag pa gso byed rgyas byed dang*// kun phyogs snyun byed btang 'gro dang*// rdzi bo btung bya 'og 'gro dang*// zad phyed ltung byed bde mchog dang*// sprin gyi me tog sprin gyi bcud// dba' chu rlabs kyi ming dang dba' rlabs mthor 'gro dang*// mtshar g.yo khrem mnyer bgre ldog dang*// chil sgrog ces bya rlabs kyi ming*// klong chu 'khor dang zegs ma'i ming dang chu yi 'khor lo dang*// chu 'thor thigs pa chu phru dang*// chu yi zegs ma'o rgyun

chu rgyun gyi ming 'khyog dang*// sbyor 'byed dang ni rgyug chu'o// 'di na klung dang chu klung dang*// 'bab chu chu rgyun gtsang po'o// 'grom chu ngogs kyi ming dang 'gog byed ngogs dang ni// chu ngogs dang ni chu kha dang*// pha rol tshu rol phan tshun ngogs/ ༈ /de chu srol gyi ming gnyis bar ni lhung skyob yin// 'di na chu srol zhes su grags/ ༈ /gnyis gling gi ming 'gram dbus skam chu dbus dang*// chu yi sgang yin 'di na gling*// tshal zhes la lar grags pa yod// byings 'dam rdzab kyi ming ba rdzab dang 'dam bag dang*// 'dam rdzab dang ni 'jim pa'o// bskul gru'i ming 'gro sgrol byed sgrol ba dang*// rtsa gzings 'phyos 'gro gru yi ming*/ ༈ /rgyun 'bab chu'i ming dang 'bab chu chu klung klung*/ ༈ /gru gla gru btsas kyi ming sgrol rngan 'dir mnyan gla// shing chu gzar gyi ming gis chu 'chu chu gzar yin// gzings gru nang gi skyes bu'i ming bdag gru yi tshong pa dang*// rna ba 'dzin pa gru pa dang*// gzhan las gdos pa 'dzin pa dang*// 'di na mnyan pa skya ba 'dzin// gzings kyi bdag po gru la zhon// 'dren gru nang btsugs pa'i shing gi ming shing gru thag 'dogs sa'i shing*/ ༈ /gru gru skya'i ming skul dbyu gu gdos pa yin// chu la 'dzugs pa skya ba'o// shing tog shing gi tog rtse yin// 'thor snod chu chu 'thor snod kyi ming 'thor zhes bya'o/ ༈ /dwangs chu dwangs rnyog gi ming pa chu gtsang snyigs ma can// rnyog chu dang ni chu snyigs so// gzhol chu gting ring thung gi ming ba zab pa zab mo ste// de las bzlog pa gsal le ba// 'og gzhi mi reg rab med do// chu nya ba'i ming gnas nya ba dol thogs kyang*// 'chu ba drwa ba'o nya rgya'i ming sha na yi// srad bu pa pi tra ka zer// smyug ma'i drwa ba nya 'dzin no// nya 'bigs

lcags kyu'i ming mchil pa zhes su grags// spu rings nya spyi'i ming nya dang spro ba can// 'gro ldan dang ni sna tshogs rgyu// sgong skyes rnam 'phyo byang bu can// sha ku lār+bha ga ṭa kaḥ/ ༈ /mche nya'i bye brag gi ming ba stong ldan rgyab mtho dang*// steng 'gro dang ni shi shu kaḥ /tsi li tsi ma 'dam bu'i nya// proṣ+ṭhi nya gzhon nu la dang ni sha ba rī// sgo nga phra mo'i nya tshogs la// tshang ma'o de bzhin ri ṣaḥdang*// ro hi ta dang maṅku raḥ// shā la dang ni rā dzī ba// sha ku la dang ti miḥdang*/ ༈ /nya chu srin sogs srog chags kyi ming mid la sogs chu srin ni// nya yi rigs gtogs de'i bye brag /byis pa gsod dang shaṅka ba// ma ka rā la sogs pa rnams// ku li ra dang karka ṭa'o/ ༈ /shugs ngan dang ni kra ma thra// 'gram skyong dang ni grī ha dang*// spa skong 'di na rus sbal zer/ ༈ /na kra dang ni kum+bhi ra'o// sa yi 'khri shing srog chags dang*// da byid skyon gor rnam grangs yin/ ༈ /khrag 'thung dang ni dza lau kaḥ// chu shig pa yin 'dir pad pa// 'ga' zhig srog chags pad+ma zer/ ༈ /mu tig s+pho ṭaḥrnam grangs yin// mu tig skyed la 'dir nya phyis// nya skyogs kyang de dung dang ni// kam+bu ra dang dung phran no// chu yi nya phyis nya skyogs so/ ༈ /sbal pa dbyar skyes 'phar 'gro dang*// dardu ra'o rus sbal mo// du liḥzhes bya maṅku ra'o// chung ma rwa can ma zhes grags// khron 'khyil chu'i ming pa rab 'dren chu skyob dang*// mu khyud can yin rdzing rdzing bu'i ming bu dang*// yongs bskos dang ni lhas bskos pa'o/ ༈ /pad+ma'i mtsho bran sogs kyi ming 'byung gnas sgra ldan dang*// chu gnas 'bab pa mtsho yin te// chu ngan 'tshe'u rdzing bu dang*// rdzing rings rdzing gi bye brag yin/ ༈ /sgra ldan chu spyi'i ming 'gyus 'gro dba' rlabs can// zi ma can dang chu ngogs can// klung can dang ni g.yo ba can// rgyun can dang ni gling can ma// 'dzag ldan gzhol 'gro mtshor 'bab bo/

༈ /gaṅgā gaṅgā'i ming dang ni khyab 'jug rkang*// dzah+nu'i bu mo lha yi chu// skal ldan shing rta lam gsum 'bab// rgyun gsum pa dang 'jigs pa'i ma/ ༈ /rtsod ya mu nā'i ming ldan nyi ma'i bu mo dang*// zhi ba'i sring mo ya mu nā// re sin+dhu la wā ta dang narma dā// zlas byung de cha'i bu mo dang*// lag chu dang ni rtag pa'i chu// dpung sitā'i ming pas byin dang dkar po 'bab// si tā druḥdang brgyar gyes dang*// zhags pa grol dang bi pāṣ+ṭa/ ༈ /dmar chu bo gzhan gyi ming skya dang ni gser dngul lo// 'dam bu can dang dba' can dang*// zla ba'i cha dang dbyangs can ma// kā be rā dang sa ri ta// gzhan yang bye brag du ma yod// chu bo 'dres pa chu bo 'dus// chu yi lam ni wa ti'o/ ༈ /dri me tog gi dri'i ming bzangs chu 'phrog yid tshim dang*// mtshams dmar de bzhin steng ut+pal spyi la du 'thung*// ku ba la gnyis ut+pal ming*// sngo de'i bye brag sogs kyi ming na in+d+ri bā ra ste// dkar na sa sgrogs sa mos so// de yi sdong bu sha lu ka /chu yi lo ma bum pa can// chu yi sngo ni she be la// chur nyal 'di na zi ma zer// ku mud mang po yid mos tshal// pad+ma pad+ma spyi bye brag sogs kyi ming mang po na li ni// pad can pad tshal pad+ma'i tshogs// rkang 'gros bcings bzang rtsibs rnyed dang*// ut+pal chen po 'dab stong pa// chu rgyun 'dab brgya chur nyal dang*/ chu skyes chur gnas mtshor skyes dang*// ze 'bru'i 'phreng ldan sdong bu skyes// chab 'khrungs dang ni puṣ+ka ra// puṇ+ḍa rī ka pad+ma dkar// dmar na mtsho skyes ut+pa la// dmar po ko ka na da zer/ ༈ /sdong sdong bu'i ming bu dang ni chu ba dang*// rkang bu dang ni ngar pa sogs// me tog rnams kyi rtsa ba yin/ ༈ /snying lte ba la po shi phā kan+daḥni// dbus yin ze

ge sar gyi ming 'bru skra rdul dang*// ze ba ge sar rnam grangs so/ ༈ /legs 'dab ma'i ming par 'phel ba 'dab ma gsar// lte ba sa bon mdzod yin no// sa 'og gi sde'o// //mtho ris mkha' dang phyogs dus blo// sgra sogs gar dang bcas pa dang*// sa 'og gdengs can dmyal ba chu// de dag dang ni 'brel bcas bshad// 'chi med mdzod las bshad bzhin 'dir dgos rnams// sgra don ji bzhin bsgyur nas ngas 'di bshad// da dung legs cha du ma yod mod kyi// phal cher nyung la dga' phyir re zhig bzhag /grags dang ma grags brda dang brda min dang*// sgra 'gyur legs nyes bsgyur dang ma bsgyur dang*// khams dang nyer sgyur 'chad lugs tha dad dang*// mi 'dra'i dbye ba gzhan du ngas bshad mod// gzhung bshad pa dang snyan ngag sbyor 'dod rnams// legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyi rjes 'jug pa'i// tshig gi gter 'di zung la gang dgos sbyor// lhar bcas 'jig rten dga' ba'i tshig yin no// //dge ba 'di yis bdag dang sems can rnams// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun la rab yangs blos// dpal 'byor dge legs kun gyi gnas bsgrubs te// thams cad gzigs pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog/ //tshig gi gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos 'di ni yongs su grags pa'i shes bya'i gnas phal mo che blo yul du byas pa/ sgra dang*/ tshad ma dang*/ sdeb sbyor dang*/ tshig gi rgyan dang*/ snyan ngag dang*/ ming gi mngon brjod dang*/ rtsis dang*/ sman dpyad dang*/ bzo'i gnas la sogs pa mkhas pa rnams 'jug pa'i yan lag thams cad la sbyangs shing*/ lung dang rigs pa'i de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par khong du chud pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du legs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
